title: Agnus (Carpentras, Missa Se mieulx ne vient (Channay 1532))
desc: Carpentras (Elzéar Genet), Missa Se mieulx ne vient (Channay 1532), Agnus. 6 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Channay 1532. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
